Code 128 encoder files vendored unchanged from JsBarcode 3.12.3 (npm package
`jsbarcode`, `bin/barcodes/Barcode.js` and the required `bin/barcodes/CODE128`
modules). Source: https://github.com/lindell/JsBarcode . MIT license included.
Only the encoder is used; rendering uses the mini-program's native 2D canvas.
